name: Judgment
description: The Ironpriest calls down a sentence of light that crushes a single heretic.

runes.name: Final Verdict
runes.description: The sentence is harsher and cheaper, sparing the Ironpriest's faith.

runes.name: Pyre of Light
runes.description: The light falls as burning judgement rather than a clean blow.

runes.name: Mercy
runes.description: A lighter sentence that condemns the target for much longer.

name: Bulwark
description: Faith hardens into a shield of light around the Ironpriest's body.

effects.text: A wall of light absorbs incoming blows.
Aura: the Ironpriest's armour is reinforced.

runes.name: Bastion
runes.description: A fortress of light that holds for far longer.

runes.name: Reprisal
runes.description: A shorter, cheaper guard that answers every blow with faith.

name: Radiant Aura
description: A ring of golden light burns the unwy around the Ironpriest.

effects.text: Radiant Aura burns every foe that closes in.
Aura: the Ironpriest's armour is reinforced.

runes.name: Dawn
runes.description: The light floods a far wider circle of the pit.

runes.name: Devotion
runes.description: A shorter prayer that keeps the Ironpriest's guard raised for longer.

name: Consecrated Blade
description: The Ironpriest's weapon is blessed with burning light for a single mighty swing.

effects.text: The blessed swing smites the target.
Holy fire keeps burning the wound.

runes.name: Warden Relic
runes.description: A heavier blow from an old relic, paid for in a longer prayer.

runes.name: Pyre Edge
runes.description: The blessing burns far hotter on the blade.

name: Sanctuary
description: A brief sanctuary of golden light mends the Ironpriest's wounds.

effects.text: Sanctuary restores nearly a third of the Ironpriest's health.
The prayer returns a measure of Faith.

runes.name: Grace
runes.description: A deeper sanctuary that mends far more but must be earned again slowly.

runes.name: Sanctuary Ward
runes.description: A quicker sanctuary that keeps mending the Ironpriest long after the light fades.
